gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the QNAP TVS-h674's 'faster' desktop CPU (i5-12400 / i3-12100) has a 24-EU UHD 730 iGPU, against 80 EU on the i5-1235U (UGREEN DXP6800 Pro, TerraMaster F6-424 Max), 64 EU on the i3-1315U (TerraMaster F6-425 Pro) and 80 EU on the Core 5 120U (DXP6800 Ultra). The footnote: Intel's 'Iris Xe' name for the 80-EU part applies only with dual-channel memory, and Notebookcheck found the DXP6800 Pro ships with a single 8 GB module.
standout_why: Compared against Starry Hope's 'Best NAS for Plex in 2026 With Quick Sync' (cited in one chat): it names no iGPU, gives no EU counts and says nothing about memory channels. It only calls each Intel box 'Quick Sync' and 'Yes, with HDR tone mapping'. Notebookcheck's DXP6800 Pro review (cited twice) says the unit ships with 'an 8 GB DDR5 module' but never names the iGPU or the channel mode, and runs no transcode test. QNAP's TVS-h674 hardware-spec page (cited in every chat) says 'Intel UHD Graphics 730' but gives no EU count. ChatGPT's own answers rate the QNAP 'Excellent' for Plex, and one says its faster desktop CPU 'does not automatically make it a better Plex transcoder', without the reason. Our current page gives '80 EU' only for the Ultra. Raidsize, B&H compare pages, the Asustor datasheet and the Plex support article were not opened: B&H and Plex returned 403, and I ran out of budget for the others.
decides: It supports the existing pick, DXP6800 Pro (or F6-424 Max) over the TVS-h674 for a Plex-first buyer. The $2,139–2,349 QNAP pairs its stronger CPU with the smallest iGPU in the group (24 EU vs 80), and it still needs a 10GbE card. Inference with no named source: EU count matters most for GPU-shader work such as HDR tone mapping, while basic decode/encode runs on the fixed-function Quick Sync media engine. The single-module footnote gives a cheap tweak, not a pick change: fill the second SO-DIMM slot so the i5-1235U runs dual-channel (Intel's Iris Xe condition). I found no named measurement of what single-channel memory costs Plex on these units.
